name: Two! Three! (Hoping For More Good Days) (둘! 셋! (그래도 좋은 날이 더 많기를))

lines.lyric: Been trying to tell you this
lines.lyric_hangul: Been trying to tell you this
lines.lyric_translation: Been trying to tell you this

lines.lyric: I was supposed to tell you this
lines.lyric_hangul: I was supposed to tell you this
lines.lyric_translation: I was supposed to tell you this
Let’s only walk on flower paths

lines.lyric: Ije joheun ilman isseul georan mal
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제 좋은 일만 있을 거란 말
lines.lyric_translation: Only good things will happen now
You’re idols so / I don’t have to listen to you to know you suck

lines.lyric: Neone gasa mame an deureo an bwado bidione
lines.lyric_hangul: 너네 가사 맘에 안 들어 안 봐도 비디오네
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t like your lyrics, it’s obvious

lines.lyric_hangul: 너넨 힘 없으니 구린 짓 분명히 했을텐데
lines.lyric_translation: You have no power / So you probably did something fishy

lines.lyric_hangul: 너네 하는 짓들 보니 조금 있음 망하겠네
lines.lyric_translation: Seeing what you’ve done, I know you’re gonna fail / (Thank you so much)

parts.lyric: Neone haneun jitdeul boni jogeum iteum manghagetne

lines.lyric_translation: because of your own inferiority complex

lines.lyric_hangul: 덕분에 고딩 때도 못한 증명 해냈으니
lines.lyric_translation: You proved that you’re worse / Than you were in high school

lines.lyric: Baksu jjakjjak geurae gyesok jjuk haera jjuk
lines.lyric_hangul: 박수 짝짝 그래 계속 쭉 해라 쭉

lines.lyric: Urin urikkiri haengbokhalge good yeah I’m good
lines.lyric_hangul: 우린 우리끼리 행복할게 good yeah I'm good
lines.lyric_translation: We’re gonna be happy on our own, good yeah I’m good

lines.lyric: Gwaenchanha ja hana dul set hamyeon ijeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜찮아 (괜찮아) 자 하나 둘 셋 하면 잊어 (잊어)
lines.lyric_translation: It’s alright, now count 1, 2, 3 and forget

lines.lyric: Gwaenchanha ja hana dul set hamyeon ijeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜찮아 (괜찮아) 자 하나 둘 셋 하면 잊어 (잊어)
lines.lyric_translation: It’s alright, now count 1, 2, 3 and forget
Hold each others hands and smile
Still, I hope there will be good days

lines.lyric: Nae mareul mitneundamyeon hana dul set
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 말을 믿는다면 하나 둘 셋 (하나 둘 셋)
믿는다면 하나 둘 셋 (하나 둘 셋)

lines.lyric: Geuraedo joheun nari hwolssin deo manhgireul
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래도 좋은 날이 훨씬 더 많기를
lines.lyric_translation: Still, I hope there are way more good days

lines.lyric: Nae mareul mitneundamyeon hana dul set
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 말을 믿는다면 하나 둘 셋 (하나 둘 셋)
믿는다면 하나 둘 셋 (하나 둘 셋)

lines.lyric: Mudae dwi geurimja soge na, eodum soge na
lines.lyric_hangul: 무대 뒤 그림자 속의 나, 어둠 속의 나
lines.lyric_translation: Behind the stage, I’m in the shadow, I’m in the darkness
I didn’t want to show you my pain
But I still lack so much
I only wanted to make you smile
For handling these tears and scars
For being a flower in the most beautiful moment of life
